cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. The police said in August 2024 the pre-war registry system was recovered and running, but the 2026 sources show electronic birth certificates resuming office by office.
cells.note: The registry's recovery (2024) and its database restored in full (November 2026) concern the pre-war data, while the 2026 facts show electronic registration widening office by office; the newest stand, so stage 2. Question 2 needs its own evidence, so the death module does not lift it.
